card.name: Same time each day wording
card.fires_on: The word completing a timing phrase such as "the same time", "the same day" or "any time" in dosing directions. It sits on time, of, day or days just before "each day" or "of day".

modes.label: Same time/day phrase
modes.description: Fires on time, day or of inside "at the same time of day" or "on the same day each week".
modes.example: Administer KOMZIFTI orally at about the same<< time>> each day.

modes.label: Counting days or progress
modes.description: Fires on a unit word in a count or on "up" in "up to this point".
modes.example: or combination of these drugs for 10 or more<< days>> per month) may lead to exacerbation

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a timing phrase and away from "onward" type words, but the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the last words of "at the same time every day" in dosing directions.
